{{Top}}
'''Mammavians''' was a classification for [[Species/Legends|creatures]] that exhibited the characteristics of both [[Mammal/Legends|mammalian]] and [[Bird/Legends|avian]] creatures. The [[Rawwk/Legends|Rawwks]] of [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] were such creatures. The [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], [[Quor'sav/Legends|Quor'sav]] also had characteristics of both [[monotreme]]s and mammavians.
